title: 'Eric Ries was able to put into word many concepts I thought about but didn't really know how to articulate.'
summary: Federica is an early-stage founder who spent months looking for guidance on structuring a company so that its mission stays protected, and says nothing else she read came close. Her Goodreads review credits the book's examples with giving her language she can use on other founders and investors, and she ends by pressing investors to read it too: the structures Ries proposes need capital willing to back them.
blockquote: This is one of the best books I have read recently, and I can't recommend it enough. I am an early founder, and I spent the last months trying to figure out how to build a company that is mission-protected. I read a number of books and articles, but none hit the mark like Incorruptible. Eric Ries was able to put into word many concepts I thought about but didn't really know how to articulate.
